title: Pentagon signs classified-network AI deals with seven firms, excluding Anthropic
summary: The Defense Department signed agreements with Google, OpenAI, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, SpaceX and Reflection to deploy AI on classified networks, aiming for an 'AI-first fighting force'; Anthropic remains designated a supply-chain risk.
reason: Major multi-vendor military AI contracts; continuing Anthropic dispute over autonomous weapons/surveillance limits.
